verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.gitlab.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with GitLab Documentation content, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. However, the probe for per-page markdown docs returned 404, and nothing describes the file's scope or structure. Missing for 10: documented llms.txt scope/contents (e.g., llms-full.txt or page index depth), markdown versions of docs pages, first-party documentation or independent corroboration of agent-oriented docs usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
